name: agent-workbench
description: Portable task orchestration, deterministic code review, safe loop discovery, and opt-in pull-request evidence preparation.

interface.shortDescription: Route work, review code, discover loops, and draft PR evidence
interface.longDescription: Agent Workbench coordinates bounded, independently verified subagent work, runs deterministic evidence-backed code review, discovers recurring work suitable for safe agent loops, and prepares privacy-safe pull-request evidence locally before separately authorized GitHub mutation. Loop proposals remain inactive until separately authorized.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Workbench to orchestrate this task through bounded subagents.
Use Agent Workbench to review one PR or local diff with applicable technology overlays.
Use Agent Workbench to discover safe loops or prepare local PR evidence.
